name: Cerebras GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast (750 tok/s)
notes: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast at up to 750 output tokens/sec. 11x faster than Fable 5, 5x faster than Opus 4.8 Fast. HLE benchmark: 2500 questions in 11h11m vs 78h27m for Claude Fable 5. Weights stay on-chip (44 GB SRAM), tokens flow through pipelined layers across wafers.
